kappa.label: kappa
kappa.role: Odd central element; appears in [X,Y]_gamma = [X,Y]_0 + kappa*gamma(X,Y)

K.label: K
K.role: Even central element; identified with scalar 1 in all current applications

gb_matrix.description: Inhomogeneous deformation parameters for C(n+1). Deformed exchange relation: [b_j^s, a_1^sigma] = -gb_{sigma,j,s} * kappa. Gram matrix: (a_1^sigma | b_j^s) = gb_{sigma,j,s} in the pre-oscillator bilinear form.
gb_matrix.gram_matrix_convention: Row index: sigma in {+,-} (a_1^sigma); Column index: (j, s) ordered (1,+),(1,-),(2,+),(2,-),... gb_label format: gb_{sigma_str}{s_str}_{j}
